title: The evolving content of BioScience
content: We are pleased to introduce a new submission category, Key Challenges, articles that summarize the important challenges and questions that need to be addressed. We especially seek submissions that prioritize unaddressed challenges or questions for a field. The first to be published in BioScience is “Evolvability: Progress and key questions” (https://doi.org/10.1093/biosci/biaf111), written by Pélabon and colleagues (with an initial push by W. Scott Armbruster). They focus on the ability of biological systems to evolve and how this ability itself can evolve. What especially struck me about their article is the demonstration of the fine-toothed comb of natural selection, which can nonrandomly sift through complex genetic phenomena to favor even the evolution of the basic parameters of the evolutionary process.
